mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT p.perm_code AS permCode, p.perm_name AS permName, p.perm_type AS permType, p.path AS path, p.method AS method FROM sys_permission p INNER JOIN sys_role_permission rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id INNER JOIN sys_user_role ur ON rp.role_id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND p.deleted = 0 ORDER BY p.sort_order, p.id
